fresh_campaign_binding.note: Evidence binding only; future CURRENT must be Fresh Read again.

new_stage.contribution: The failed naive line-mean score term was exactly decomposed. The target rider's own-score contribution worsened C1 in all four fixed W1 blocks, while the same-line peer contribution excluding own score improved C1 in all four blocks. The failed full naive term is therefore dominated by own-score reinjection rather than absence of useful peer information.

updated_integrated_mechanism_conclusion.label: SELF_REINJECTION_DOMINANT_WITH_PEER_SIGNAL_PRESENT_SYNTHETIC_ONLY
updated_integrated_mechanism_conclusion.statement: The current Synthetic evidence supports a coherent sequence. Canonical W1 contains useful hidden line-shared state; supplying the exact hidden state to C1 strongly improves it and reverses N1's prior W1 advantage. A naive PRE line-mean score aggregate fails because it mixes same-line peer information with the target rider's own already-used noisy score. Exact cause decomposition shows the own-score reinjection is strongly harmful, while the peer-only same-denominator component is informative in the opposite direction. Thus naive-proxy failure should not be interpreted as evidence that peer-line PRE information lacks signal. Measurement-error analysis is consistent with the own-score reinjection harm. None of this establishes a deployable feature or real-world mechanism.
updated_integrated_mechanism_conclusion.relationship_to_prior_synthesis: v2 established hidden shared-state value but failure of the naive full line mean. v3 localizes that failure to own-score reinjection/double counting and shows that peer information was not the failing component.

A_DOUBLECOUNTING.plain_meaning: C1 already uses the rider's own score, and the naive line mean feeds part of that same score in again.

B_SELF_CONTAMINATION.plain_meaning: Including the target rider in its own shared-state estimate creates the same harmful own-score reinjection term.

C_MEASUREMENT_NOISE.plain_meaning: Observed score is noisy. Reusing the same noisy own score adds much more correlated noise than adding peer scores.

D_AGGREGATION_BIAS.plain_meaning: The simulator's hidden W1 target is itself an arithmetic line mean, so the mean operator alone is not the leading explanation. Nonlinear prediction effects remain possible.

critical_scope_interpretation.peer_diagnostic_result: PEER-only same-denominator control has lower Synthetic W1 expected log loss than C1 and N1 on the fixed reused fixtures.
critical_scope_interpretation.reason: PEER was authorized only as an algebraic cause-decomposition component after the naive-proxy failure. Converting the favorable post-result component into a feature/model candidate would be result-driven scope expansion and would violate the Owner's cause-decomposition-only direction.

what_is_now_falsified_or_weakened_within.claim: Naive PRE line-mean score failed because same-line peer PRE information is intrinsically useless.
what_is_now_falsified_or_weakened_within.basis: The peer-only exact decomposition component improved C1 in all four fixed blocks.

what_is_now_falsified_or_weakened_within.claim: The target rider's own-score inclusion is harmless within the naive line mean.
what_is_now_falsified_or_weakened_within.basis: The SELF-only component worsened C1 strongly in all four blocks.

what_is_now_falsified_or_weakened_within.claim: Arithmetic averaging itself is obviously the principal source of failure.
what_is_now_falsified_or_weakened_within.basis: Canonical W1 hidden state is itself an arithmetic mean of latent skill; the empirical decomposition instead localizes harm to the own-score contribution.

still_open: Whether the favorable peer diagnostic survives a separately authorized prospective feature-candidate protocol rather than retrospective cause decomposition.
Whether renormalizing peer information, residualizing it against own score, or applying measurement-error shrinkage would help; none was executed or authorized here.
Whether any analogous peer/shared-state mechanism exists in real keirin.
Whether any lawful real-world PRE feature, architecture, or model has predictive superiority.
Whether any model has economic, bankroll, ROI, deployment, or wagering value.

next_scientific_boundary.minimal_question_if_owner_later_wants_mo: Should a peer-only PRE shared-state representation be opened as a prospective, independently prespecified Research/Candidate feature question rather than a post-result diagnostic component?
next_scientific_boundary.why_boundary: The current favorable PEER result was discovered inside a cause-decomposition experiment. Treating it as a candidate feature or optimizing its normalization/coefficient after observing the result would change the scientific purpose and create selection bias unless opened under a new prospective gate.
